statements.name: count_by_status
statements.title: Count by status, every order
statements.sql: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

statements.name: revenue_by_month
statements.title: Revenue by month, orders joined to customers
statements.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS month, date_trunc('year', c.created_at) AS signup_year, sum(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

statements.name: revenue_by_month_kathmandu
statements.title: Revenue by month in Asia/Kathmandu, orders joined to customers
statements.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at) AS month, date_trunc('year', c.created_at) AS signup_year, sum(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
